subject: Include runtime dependencies in dev snapshot
base_source: rs-864df4cc: the clean variant is copied from it; the seeded variant adds one defect

clean.description: The change as committed. No defect is planted.

seeded.seed: in parseArgs, the value lookup order changed so that the next argument is read before the inline value
seeded.description: parseArgs reads an option's value from its inline form (--target=<dir>) when present, and only otherwise from the next argument. The seed reads the next argument first, so an inline value is taken only when no next argument exists.
seeded.consequence: parseArgs(['--target=/x', '--commit', 'HEAD']) sets the target to '--commit' and then rejects 'HEAD' as an unknown argument. A snapshot can be refused, or written to the wrong target when the next token is a path.

diff_check: seeded change.diff = the clean change.diff with the seeded file's section replaced by git diff --no-index of parent against the seeded file
